name: LegoZendo2
author: chris (spec) / orchestrator (implementation)
description: Lego Zendo 2. Clue: two distinct capital letters a,b + number y in 0..12. Same brick/connection model as LegoZendo v3 (two orientations, same-orientation pin-axis adjacency with pin width 1..3, no connectivity requirement). EXACTLY y of the 2-pin connections must join one brick of letter a to one brick of letter b. a-a and b-b 2-pin connections and 1/3-pin a-b connections are decoys. solve() as in LegoZendo: near-uniform width histogram, >= 5y connections, >= 5 distinct letters, decoy a/b bricks that add no 2-pin a-b edge.
